title: [Bug]: Triton block quantized (e.g. MXFP4) MoE kernels producing NaNs due to OOB reads on scale values
author: yzong-rh

comments.author: yzong-rh
comments.body:
Update: 

The specific issue is fixed on Triton main but has not yet made it into a release. Updating the vLLM side to use the new kernels once they release will require some work however since the new kernels have slightly different interface.

A temporary solution could be to patch `convert_layout` to pad and zero out and pad the scale values.

comments.author: yzong-rh
comments.body: Patched. To be cleaned up once Triton v.3.8.0+ kernels are released and used.
